# github-markdown-css

`github-markdown-dark.css` and `LICENSE` are the unmodified dist files from
github-markdown-css 5.9.0, MIT, © Sindre Sorhus.

- Release: `https://github.com/sindresorhus/github-markdown-css/releases/tag/v5.9.0`
- Dist file: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/github-markdown-css@5.9.0/github-markdown-dark.css`
- No build step; styles anything inside a `.markdown-body` element.

Used by the console's F1 command reference for GitHub's Markdown styling.
